gen-gf-paprika-gf-carrois-gothic: Loud, loose letters with room to stretch. Paprika scatters wide, capital-like lowercase across the line, while Carrois Gothic, a plain sans, keeps a high x-height and open c easy to follow.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Spread-out letters that fill the line. Paprika makes its lowercase fill the line like capitals, while Noto Sans Kannada, a plain sans, steps up only gently from small letters to capitals.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-funnel-sans: Wide-spaced letters with a lazy swagger. Revalia stretches out with an open-curved g, and Funnel Sans, a plain sans, holds its strokes steady from stem to curve; that gap in temperament is the draw.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Showy, spread-out letters with a slow, easy gait. Revalia stretches wide with an open-bottomed g, while Noto Sans Bengali, a sans, stays modest, its capitals barely above lowercase and its letter mouths open.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Bold, stretched-out letters with room to strut. Revalia sprawls in a relaxed stride while Noto Sans Kaithi, a plain sans, keeps an open channel in the e; that tension is the whole appeal.
